caption: A microphone on a stand is tapped, and the mic head jiggles on its clip with each tap.

sa.check: The mic head jiggles on its clip.
There are several taps in the clip.
Each tap comes before its jiggle.

pc.expect: The mic is still until tapped and each jiggle begins at a tap.
pc.fail: The mic jiggles before the finger touches it; or jiggles with the hand away; or the finger taps and the mic stays dead still.

pc.expect: Each jiggle shrinks after its tap and settles before or as the next tap comes.
pc.fail: The jiggle grows after a tap with the hand away; or stops dead in a tilted pose; or the mic keeps jiggling unchanged with no further taps.

pc.expect: The mic moves away from the finger's push and swings back about its clip.
pc.fail: The mic moves toward the tapping finger; or moves in a direction unrelated to the tap; or jumps up out of the clip and settles back.

pc.expect: The stand and the mic body are rigid; the clip flexes.
pc.fail: The stand bends like rubber; or the mic body flexes; or the cable stretches.

pc.expect: One microphone on one stand; the finger does not pass through the mic.
pc.fail: A second microphone appears; or the mic vanishes; or the finger passes through the mic; or the stand changes shape.

pc.expect: The mic's colour, the stand's height and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The mic changes colour; or the stand changes height; or the background changes.

note: The tapping hand is a trigger and is not judged.
